## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation you are running into. What is currently missing or inconvenient?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you would like to see added or changed.

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative approaches or workarounds you have already tried or considered, and why they
did not fully address the problem.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references that support this request.
